digest.component_or_area: external integration test suite and CI/CD workflows
propositions: The external integration test suite currently runs live tests against only one provider (Anthropic) instead of all credentialed providers (Anthropic, Bedrock, OpenAI), leaving provider-specific regressions undetectable by CI

Provider selection must be implemented as an explicit matrix dimension using REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE with overlay files setting [llm.model_classes], rather than ambient environment defaults or deprecated bare REBAR_LLM_MODEL

The Bedrock arm must authenticate via OIDC role assumption (aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials) on GitHub-hosted runners, not EC2 instance roles, and must explicitly set both AWS_DEFAULT_REGION and REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION to avoid silent failures
Missing credentials for a matrix arm must produce a loud, visible skip rather than masking as a green pass, distinguishing credential absence from successful execution
Configuration overlays must not leave fallback paths (such as cfg.model resolving to DEFAULT_MODEL) that inadvertently route requests to the default provider instead of the intended one
Tests guarding the multi-provider abstraction must assert against all resolution paths that determine provider selection, not just the explicit class table
